page: OVHcloud b2-7 is a general-purpose server instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Haswell CPU with 2 dedicated physical cores and 2 vCPUs operating at 2.0 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 7.0 GB of RAM, providing 3.5 GB of memory per core, and is bundled with 50 GB of local SSD storage. Network capabilities include a baseline bandwidth of 0 Gbps, and the instance comes with one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Performance benchmarks place this instance in the lower tiers. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance is rated as weak at 1072.92, while the multi-core performance falls into the poor category at 2156.87. Memory bandwidth tests show 178.89 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 25.07 GB/sec for uncached large blocks, both categorized as weak. Computational benchmarks like Geekbench yield a single-core score of 926.0 and a multi-core score of 1573.0, reflecting poor performance relative to higher-tier instances.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the b2-7 offers a low-cost entry point for workloads requiring dedicated CPU resources rather than shared-core burstable models, though it trades off raw processing speed and memory bandwidth. It is suited for lightweight workloads such as basic static web serving, which registers a throughput of 2.84 GB/sec, simple database operations, and low-intensity background tasks.
